items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Grover Mitchell was never in the band when I was in the band, but Grover Mitchell he did some leading

ctx.x: Grover Mitchell. Grover Mitchell. Grover Mitchell.
Grover Mitchell. Well now see, Grover Mitchell was never in the band when I was in the band, but Grover Mitchell he did some leading, is he leading that band now?

Do you know who‘s leading it? Well you know, you were in that band as you were talking about Frank Foster, you were in that band called the New Testament, the New Testament Count Basie Band, right? The band in the ‗50s and the early ‗60s.
